Name: Witchy Crystals
Author: CozyPsychologist
Description:
[size=4]This mod adds  27 handcrafted decorative pieces spanning crystals, idols, shrines, charms, paintings, and more available in the furniture catalogue you can buy at Robin's. [/size]

[list]
[*][size=4]5 geodes[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]3 small crystals[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]2 fireplaces[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]1 large bookshelf[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]2 wall charms[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]1 painting[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]4 large indoor/outdoor statement pieces[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]1 indoor crystal shrine/cabinet[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]And more[/size][/*]
[/list]
Requirements: 
[list]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
